seed_separation.generate_seed: dataset generation only; replicate i uses generate_seed + i * 1009
seed_separation.train_seed: splits and model training only; replicate i uses train_seed + i * 17

selective_regularized.note: Selective v1 is retained. This variant adds regularized species-specific deviations in nonlinear growth and treatment response. Deviations shrink toward the shared mean; they are not unpenalized species RE.

regularization.growth: ridge inflation on SPECIES × time-basis coefficients (lambda_growth)
regularization.transformer: phase1 target fit; phase2 extra L2 of species/growth tokens toward phase1 and treatment-deviation head toward 0
regularization.treatment: ridge inflation on SPECIES × exposure/dose coefficients (lambda_treatment)

selective_sharing.note: Shared: compound descriptors and planned-dose/regimen query features. Species-specific: growth/baseline token groups and residual scale. Not a Bayesian species random-effect variant.

uncertainty.parameter_uncertainty: Incompletely estimated except for a reliable Bayesian posterior. Spline bootstraps the mean only; covariance is not bootstrapped; transformer n_members=1 has no bootstrap spread.
uncertainty.predictive_variability: HierarchicalCovariance study, animal, and residual draws in sample_study.
